title: Sri Vinayaka Group - Official Portal
description: Official corporate homepage of Sri Vinayaka Group, premier transportation and logistics provider in South India.
content: Sri Vinayaka Group connects Bangalore and Coorg with premium AC sleeper buses, overnight express cargo logistics, and holiday tour charters. Driven by Trust, operating BharatBenz fleet with fixed 21:30 and 21:50 departures and 24 boarding stops across Karnataka.

title: Bangalore to Coorg AC Sleeper Bus Services
description: Overnight luxury AC sleeper coach booking between Bangalore and Coorg with BharatBenz fleet and Bitla reservation system.
content: Daily overnight luxury AC sleeper buses running between Bangalore and Kodagu (Coorg). Features include 2+1 layout, privacy curtains, USB/Type-C charging, individual AC vents, reading lights, clean blankets, 24 boarding stops including Madiwala, Majestic, Rajajinagar, Yeshwantpur, Madikeri, Virajpet, Gonikoppa, Kushalnagar. Departures at 21:30 and 21:50 daily. Official Bitla partner.

title: Express Overnight Logistics & Parcel Delivery
description: Next-morning parcel and cargo delivery across Bangalore, Coorg, Mysore, and South India commercial hubs.
content: Guaranteed overnight parcel and cargo transport connecting Bangalore, Mysore, Virajpet, Madikeri, and Gonikoppa. Cutoff booking time 6:00 PM for guaranteed 7:00 AM counter pickup next morning. Services include commercial goods, coffee and spice agricultural produce, machinery parts, documents, cartons, and secure freight forwarding.

title: Weekend Getaway Trips, School Tours & Luxury Bus Charters
description: Custom weekend getaways, safe school and college educational trips, Coorg plantation trails, and luxury bus charters.
content: Customizable travel and tour packages across South India including Coorg coffee plantation trails, Mysore royal palaces, weekend getaways with DJ sound and ambient lights, safe school excursions, college campus tours, dance academy cultural visits, and 30-45 seater luxury coach charters.

title: About Sri Vinayaka Group - Vision, Mission & Fleet
description: Company background, values, safety standards, and fleet information for Sri Vinayaka Group.
content: Founded on principles of punctuality, passenger safety, and cargo integrity, Sri Vinayaka Group operates modern BharatBenz sleeper coaches and express cargo trucks. Headquartered in Virajpet, Coorg with major logistics terminals and booking offices in Bangalore.
